## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2002. The usage-exporter pod in the analytics namespace was failing to start because the `harbor-pull` image pull secret required to authenticate with the Harbor registry didn't exist in that namespace. While the manifests were copied to the new namespace, the image pull secret was not. I provided the ticket owner with the specific command to copy the secret from the reporting namespace to the analytics namespace, which will resolve the ImagePullBackOff error.
